'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kharkiv strikes (2022–present)|Kharkiv strikes]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] strike [[Kharkiv]] with [[guided bomb]]s, killing at least two people and injuring six others. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-strike-kills-least-two-ukraines-kharkiv-say-officials-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*An [[Israeli police]] officer is injured in a stabbing by a [[Turkey|Turkish]] national in the [[Old City of Jerusalem]]. The assailant was fatally shot by other responding officers at the scene. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/turkish-national-stabs-israeli-policeman-jerusalem-is-shot-dead-police-statement-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Kenya floods]]
**The death toll from ongoing [[flood]]ing in [[Kenya]] increases to 169, with 91 people reported missing. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/interactive/2024/photos-flash-floods-kill-dozens-kenya/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*Nine people are killed and two more injured during an explosion caused by a [[gas leak]] at a restaurant in [[Beirut]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2024/04/30/lebanon-beirut-pizza-secrets-explosion/ (The National News)]
*Fifty-five people are injured after a [[Los Angeles Metro]] [[E Line (Los Angeles Metro)|light rail train]] collides with a transportation bus in [[Downtown Los Angeles|downtown Los Angeles]]. [https://www.latimes.com/california/story/2024-04-30/injuries-minor-as-la-metro-train-bus-collide-near-exposition-park (''Los Angeles Times'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Mount Ruang]] volcano in [[North Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]], erupts for the second time this month, prompting the evacuation of more than 12,000 people. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/asia/indonesias-ruang-volcano-erupts-again-alert-status-highest-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)] [https://www.voanews.com/a/indonesia-s-mount-ruang-volcano-erupts-again-tuesday/7591514.html (VOA)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Philippines relations]]
**[[Scarborough Shoal standoff]]
***[[China Coast Guard|China's coast guard]] expels a [[Philippine Coast Guard]] ship and another vessel from the waters near [[Scarborough Shoal]] in the [[South China Sea]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/chinas-coast-guard-expels-philippine-vessels-scarborough-shoal-state-media-says-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses]]
***[[2024 Columbia University pro-Palestinian campus occupation]]
****Over 100 protestors are arrested by the [[New York City Police Department|NYPD]] after attempting to occupy [[Hamilton Hall (Columbia University)|Hamilton Hall]]. [https://time.com/6973105/nypd-enter-columbia-university-campus-after-protesters-occupy-building/ (''Time'')] [https://www.nbcphiladelphia.com/news/national-international/around-100-arrested-after-columbia-university-calls-in-police-to-end-pro-palestinian-occupation/3846547/ (WCAU-TV)]
*[[2023–2024 Georgian protests]]
**Police in [[Tbilisi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], utilize a [[water cannon]], [[tear gas]], and [[stun grenades]] as part of a crackdown on protests against a law requiring foreign [[non-governmental organizations]] to register as [[foreign agent]]s. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/georgian-parliament-vote-foreign-agent-bill-second-reading-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York]]
**Judge [[Juan Merchan]] fines [[Donald Trump]] $9,000 for [[contempt of court]], and threatens to jail Trump if he continues to violate his [[gag order]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/trump-nyc-hush-money-trial-resume-with-bankers-testimony-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Hainault sword attack]]
**A man attacks people with a sword after crashing a car into a house in [[Hainault, London|Hainault]], [[London]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]], killing a 14-year-old boy and injuring four other people, including two police officers. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-68926887 (BBC News)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/04/30/world/europe/london-stabbing-hainault.html (''The New York Times'')] 
*[[France|French]] prosecutors announce that actor [[Gérard Depardieu]] will be tried for the alleged [[sexual assault]] of two women in 2021. [https://www.euronews.com/culture/2024/04/30/gerard-depardieu-to-be-tried-over-sexual-assault-allegations (euronews)]
*The founder of the [[cryptocurrency exchange]] service [[Binance]], [[Changpeng Zhao]], is sentenced to four months in prison for [[money laundering]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/binances-ceo-zhao-faces-sentencing-over-money-laundering-violations-2024-04-30/ (Reuters)]
*The [[International Court of Justice]] rejects a request by [[Nicaragua]] asking the court to order [[Germany]] to suspend aid to [[Israel]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/04/30/un-court-rejects-nicaraguas-request-for-germany-to-halt-aid-to-israel (euronews)]
